notes.title: Sunday Update
notes.notes:
Dearest early birds,
So, how did our traditional Friday update become a Sunday update? Well, we worked our asses off to push out a build (and update) on Friday, but some things went pretty wrong there. Some of you may have seen and played the buggy build that should have never gone live: especially to those, we apologize. That was not the quality we meant to deliver to you. We took down the buggy build within a few hours and put the older version back online so we could continue fixing, which we did all weekend long. With a little delay, you can now find a decent updated Woolfe on Steam.
Now, let us take you through the other stuff that went on over the past few days.


Twitch Stream Reminder
GRIN’s Wim Wouters has spent this week in the US, talking to press at GDC and PAX. By Tuesday, he will be back in Belgium and happily give you all a report on how things have been. Meet our big boss Tuesady at 8 PM GMT on our Twitch channel: http://www.twitch.tv/WoolfeGame


Granny update
Follwing the public casting, we contacted your and our favorite voice actresses for the part of Granny. Number 3 and 4 were everyone’s favorites and we are super excited to confirm now that Granny #4 is on board and recording her scenes as we speak! (http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gD8etg65xHw). She’s gonna kick ass as Red’s grandma!


Changelog
So what’s in today’s build, you wonder? 

Adjustable difficulties
You will now be able to play the game on three different difficulty settings: Easy, Medium and Hard. Think you’re up for that?

Toy Soldier editor integration
The Kickstarter backers will be pleased to know that the Toy Soldier editor is now integrated in-game! While you’re playing the game, there’s a chance you’ll encounter one of these customized soldiers. Once it’s defeated, you will see a notification on screen. These will give you extra skill-points you can afterwards use to add more upgrades to your own Toy Soldier. 
(The Toy Soldier Editor is a feature for Kickstarter backers only but none-kickstarter backers can still encounter these creations in-game. You are able to remove this option in the settings menu.)

Sewer boss-fight cutscene
We realized there were some people who had difficulty understanding what they were supposed to do when they encountered the giant sewer rat. To fix that problem we integrated a new cutscene at the beginning of the fight.

Shadow tweaking
We’ve made some adjustments concerning Red’s own shadow and we think it actually looks a lot more realistic and believable now. 

Boss fight icons
During a boss fight, you can now see that their health bars on the right hand side are accompanied by a little icon with their face on it. 

Bugfixes
No update would be complete without some bugfixes. These include:

Checkpoints: There were some issues with some checkpoints in the past. No need to worry about missing a checkpoint now.
Tutorial: In the Tutorial level, all jumps should now be doable in a single jump.
Forest chase: The traps in the forest chase level now do damage. As they should.
Collision fixes: There have been a lot of collision fixes, mainly in the Pied Piper hideout and the market chase. 


Dutch subtitles
Along with English, French and German, we’ve now added Dutch subtitles to the game. They should all be working now. Dutch unlockable content and menu stuff still needs to be implemented and adjusted. 
A big, warm ‘thank you’ to everyone who helped us with the localization! You’re truly amazing people and we’re very glad we have some devoted fans who were willing to lend us a hand!
We’d also like to ask our French, German, Dutch (and English) speaking community to keep an eye out for any flaws or mistakes in the subtitles and report them to us so we can correct them.


Meanwhile at the office…
We’re also working on lots of stuff you can not see (just yet). The localisation process is in full progress (Japanese, Russian and Spanish), we’re doing some Red re-recordings, having some new music delivered, we’re finishing off the final boss fight and scenes and are working hard on a new Woofle website for the launch of the game. Artist Bram had a lot of fun with the designs so far. Especially highlighting our game’s features :-)

http://woolfegame.com/img/woolfewebsite_sneakpeek.png

That’s all folks!
See you Tuesday on Twitch?

-The Woolfe Pack

notes.title: Twitch recap & Friday update
notes.notes:
http://woolfegame.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/4cards.png

Hello birdies!
 
We were very pleased to see last Tuesday’s Twitch stream had even more watchers than the one before. And, of course, of all the nice reviews we received and the constructive comments you all gave us.
 
We took you through the Forest Adrift level to check which areas need some improvements. We discovered the difficult areas along with a bug here and there that we’ll be fixing soon. (I’m looking at you, glitching fairies.)
 
Next Twitch: you pick!
Ok, so for our next Twitch session (on Tuesday, February 17th) we have two possible topics on the menu:

A Q&A with lead programmer Jelle on “the combat”
A Q&A with writer Yasmin on “the story”

Let us know which talk you would prefer in the comments section below this post. The most favored one is the one we’ll serve next tuesday!
 
 
Change log
 
It’s Friday so you know what that means: A new build! This build will be available later today in your Steam library so keep an eye out for this new update. We’ve fixed some bugs, added a couple new, cool features and still continue on polishing the game before the big release!
 
So… What has changed this week?

Story Mode: In addition to the previous build (in which Red could now no longer run, jump and fight in the narrative areas of the game) we also changed her animation during these scenes.
 
Sewer Bossfight: The small rats in the sewers are now not the only ones attacking Red any more. Better watch out for the giant rat you’ll now have to fight as well!
 
Combat Balancing: Along with the new key bindings integrated last week, we’ve continued to work on better balancing the combat. Mainly: the marketplace and the harbour. Your feedback is very much appreciated and we’d love to hear what you think about this new feature.
 
Mini-Market Removed: To prevent any further frustrations, we’ve removed the mini-market from the game and replaced it with the original ‘dancing guards’ again. We felt that it’d be better if we develop on the mini-market a bit better before putting it back in the game.
 
Wooden Bridge fixed: In the Forest Adrift level, you might have noticed there is a collapsible wooden bridge. The problem was that, when you died and respawned, the bridge was still broken. We managed to fix this bug and the wooden bridge should now reset properly.

http://woolfegame.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/4cards.png

Achievements and trading cards
 
A few days ago we asked you all for inspiration for (Steam) achievements and so far, we’ve received some really cool suggestions on our Facebook and Twitter channels. Keep them coming, guys! Meanwhile, the team is preparing all the artwork for the Steam badges and trading cards and will be ready to go soon.


That’s all folks!
See you next Tuesday.

Cheers,

The Woolfe Pack

notes.title: NEW UPDATE & HOMEWORK
notes.notes:
Hi there, you early access birds!

Okay… day 4 on Early Access, and what a rollercoaster it has been. We want to thank each and everyone of you for buying, liking, sharing our Woolfe - The Red Hood Diaries. For reviewing it, for giving us feedback - you’ve been a tremendous help, really.
We’re on a mission to answer and process your questions and remarks as fast as we can (finger cramp!).

NEW BUILD UPDATE LIVE: V2.0.3

Change log:
You probably noticed we pushed out a few quick-fix updates already, but we’ve also been doing some larger upgrades and fixes. Here is an overview of the most noticeable things we’ve been working on the past few days.

Pied Piper Boss-fight:

Fixed: errors in PP turn when RRH gets kicked off the platform
Fixed: RRH input control during PP start cinematic

Environment bugs:

Collision fixes in tutorial rooftops
Collision fixes in sewers
Harbour secret decor cleaned
Tutorial ledge tooltip fixed
Fixed secrets in crates
Market carriage rope fixed
Market carriage jump-cheat fixed
Market doors lock fixed
Floating rock near secret fixed
Woods chase reset fixed
Woods secret fixed
Woods holes in decor fixed

GUI / Menu:

Tooltip upgrade
Skip cinematic indicator
Keyboard input customization fix
Bug reporter fix
Music added

Programming:

No more level clipping when dying
Less camera clipping (ex: sewers ceiling)
Damage volume interval fixed (Pied Piper boss-fight)
Removed combo level-up visual from early levels
Default difficulty marked as 'coming soon'
Default language marked as 'coming soon'
Subtitles marked as 'coming soon'
Checkpoints fixed
Missing guards fixed
Remaining damage volumes in Pied Piper battle fixed


PS: A lot of people have been asking us about the subtitles… No worries, we’re on it! Integration of the English subtitles starts next week on Monday.

S.O.S. Boss Fight: join us on Twitch!
For those who are interested: we’ll be doing a live brainstorm on Twitch next tuesday about a very specific area in the Sewer Side level: 

CHECK IMAGE HERE

Looks familiar? Well, what’s to come here is a first encounter with the Pied Piper. Yes, a boss fight. 
Call for help: What do you think would be cool gameplay mechanics and ingredients to use for a boss fight featuring the Pied Piper at this underground location? If you have some spare time over the weekend, have a look at the scene, write down some ideas and join us on Twitch next week to talk about it.

The topic: Sewer Side, first boss fight with Pied Piper
When: Tuesday February 3rd, 1 PM PST (10 PM CET)
Where to go? http://www.twitch.tv/woolfegame
Who to expect? Wim Wouters (the big boss), Steven Melis (the level designer) and Jelle Voet and Yana Roggeman (the programmers) 

All other bugs, issues, questions remain very welcome on the discussions forum. We’ll be monitoring them closely. 
We will try to post an update here -with progress, questions and calls for help- every tuesday and friday from now on, so stay tuned.

Enjoy your weekend!

Cheers,

The Woolfe Pack
